lines: I have handled sharp nights before. This one nearly handled me back.
Still here, still got all my fingers, still not eager to repeat it.
I came back with a shaking hand and an empty stomach. Better than not coming back.
There was too much noise and not enough door between me and it. I found the door.
I have had hard mornings, but that night was something else entirely.
My apron has seen worse stains. My nerves have not.
I made it home, and I am counting that before I count anything else.
The cleaver stayed in my grip. So did my sense, barely.
